decision_rationale: Phase 10A achieves PHASE_10A_DATA_PARTIALLY_READY. The Cross-Sectional Daily Equity track is READY (664-669 modern sessions, up to 7,707 full sessions, 100% verified Point-in-Time constituent registry, zero survivorship bias). However, the Intraday Research track is BLOCKED / INSUFFICIENT_FOR_CONFIRMATORY due to provider retention limits on the authorized Yahoo Finance endpoint (< 60 sessions). The Options Execution track remains BLOCKED until genuine timestamped executable Bid/Ask data satisfies execution-data readiness requirements. Zero strategy backtests or alpha optimizations were performed.

gates.requirement: Phase 9.7 and Phase 9.8/9.9 baselines must remain 100% frozen and verified.
gates.observed_result: Phase 9.7: FROZEN; Phase 9.8: FROZEN; Manifest: FROZEN_IMMUTABLE.
gates.evidence_notes: All historical artifacts verified intact against canonical SHA256 checksums.

gates.evidence_notes: Exchange trading sessions (09:15-15:30 IST) and Diwali Muhurat sessions verified.

gates.requirement: Historical cross-sections evaluated at date T must use only constituents active on date T.
gates.observed_result: get_constituents_as_of(T) enforces point-in-time membership. Survivorship protection ACTIVE.

gates.requirement: Continuous multi-year intraday history (target >= 250 sessions) for confirmatory testing.
gates.observed_result: Observed provider retention ceiling: 59 sessions returned (requires >= 250 sessions).
gates.evidence_notes: Provider-specific limit on Yahoo Finance endpoint (7d for 1m, 60d for 5m). Insufficient for confirmatory research. No bars fabricated. Intraday track BLOCKED.

gates.evidence_notes: Dual reporting: modern verified window (100% clean) and maximum available historical depth.

gates.observed_result: Corporate actions logged and verified across constituent daily histories. Zero anomalous unadjusted jumps.
gates.evidence_notes: Modern 2024-2026 window has 0 invalid OHLC bars and 0 unexplained jumps.

gates.evidence_notes: Options execution remains blocked until genuine timestamped executable Bid/Ask data satisfies the Phase 10A execution-data readiness requirements. OPTIONS_EXECUTION_BACKTEST = BLOCKED; OPTIONS_PAPER_EXECUTION = BLOCKED.

gates.evidence_notes: Data inventory and provenance manifests generated in data/phase10a/.
